verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a few product-level actions that apply to many items at once: rotating a credential updates every Sprite, a single command deploys across multiple regions, and `fly scale` scales horizontally. None of these is a general bulk-operations feature for selecting and acting on many arbitrary items. Missing for 10: a documented general bulk-action capability (e.g., batch stop/destroy/update across many Machines or apps by selector), bulk API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential.
deploy to those regions with a single command
the `fly scale` command for quick horizontal and vertical scaling
